title: ha/dr: multi-AZ automation + Helm/Terraform updates + runbooks-as-code for private installer
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: Provide first-class, automated HA/DR runbooks for Private deployments. This PR updates the private-installer Helm charts and Terraform modules to support multi-AZ topologies, safe failover, and automated restore drills, and adds runbooks-as-code that can be executed by the SRE runbook runner. Changes include: updated Terraform networking to provision cross-AZ subnets and HA NAT/gateway config; Helm chart changes for leader-election, StatefulSet anti-affinity, pod disruption budgets, and readiness probes; new rollback hooks and upgrade/rollback playbooks; runbooks-as-code in /ops/runbooks (drill, failover, restore, postmortem checklist) and a simple CLI to invoke them against a target cluster; CI/test harness additions (integration tests in perf-canary job emulation); documentation updates and examples. Checklist: [x] Terraform module multi-az support implemented [x] Helm chart affinity and PDBs added [x] Automated restore-drill workflow and idempotent playbooks [x] Runbooks-as-code added and documented [x] Integration test harness for DR drill (simulated) [x] Update to installer operator to annotate leader pods for safe failover. The description below contains high-level developer notes and links to Linear tasks and support ticket SUP-1221.
